messages:
sam k: quick postmortem follow-up from last night's KV cache flap — want to capture owners and short timelines so this doesn't keep paging.
sam k: root cause summary: sudden shard imbalance + aggressive caching expiry led to a burst of cache-miss traffic. several redis alerts fired and we had noisy paging.
sam k: proposed immediate actions i pulled from the postmortem draft:
  1) audit dedupe rules and tighten fingerprinting for redis-* alerts
  2) tune thresholds for high-cardinality kv cache hits to reduce false positives
  3) adjust paging policy to require sustained violation or higher severity for paging
  4) add a temporary suppression window while we rollout the dedupe fixes
  i'll assign — comment with owner + ETA (EOD = end of day). :clock1:
elaine w: i'll take #1 (dedupe audit). will run a quick grep of alert labels and look for noisy label patterns today. aim: PR by friday EOD.
chris t: i'll do #2 (thresholds). quick thought: bump the `redis.mem.used_percent` threshold from 75 -> 85 for the high-cardinality shard alerts and add a 30s sustain. also propose rolling the dedupe window to 5m for the top-5 noisy rules. i'll post a config diff.
ryan_m: for #3 (paging): agree with raising severity gating. my proposal: only page on S0 if violation sustained > 120s OR if error rate > 2% for 1m. otherwise route to ops-batching channel only. i'll draft the policy change.
taylor: i'll own #4 (suppression window) — can add a temporary silence through Monday and attach a note in the incident. will coordinate with infra on any customer-impact checks.
oncall-bot: Incident 2023-11-09-KVCACHE acknowledged by sam k. Current silence window set by taylor until 2023-11-13T08:00Z.
chris t: putting proposed alert snippet here for feedback:
```yaml
- alert: RedisHighUsedPercentShard
  expr: redis_mem_used_percent{shard=~"kv-.*"} > 85
  for: 30s
  labels:
    severity: warning
    dedupe_key: "{{ $labels.shard }}"
```
chris t: note: adding a `dedupe_key` templated to shard will reduce cross-shard noise.
elaine w: during audit i found 3 alerts that still use `instance` tag and cause racy paging. i'll include that fix in the PR and add a short test harness to simulate churn.
sam k: great — can each owner drop a one-liner ETA in the thread so i can add timelines to the PM tracker?
elaine w: ETA: PR by Fri EOD (2023-11-10). will include tests.
chris t: ETA: config diff by today afternoon (2023-11-09), will request review from ry an.
ryan_m: ETA: policy PR by Monday morning (2023-11-13).
taylor: ETA: silence in place now, removal Monday 08:00Z, will post when removed.
sam k: thanks all. follow-ups:
- sam k: will update the postmortem with owners/timelines and ping product for any customer comms.
- ry an: can you add a small eval in staging to exercise the new dedupe key logic? (should be quick)
ryan_m: yup i can run the replay job tomorrow and post results.
chris t: once the config diff lands, please run `./scripts/alert-sim --rule RedisHighUsedPercentShard --duration 300` in staging to validate.
elaine w: also adding checklist item to run a weekly noise-report for 2 weeks to ensure no regression.
sam k: ok i'll schedule a 15m sync next Wed to verify action completion and close the postmortem — invite to follow. any blockers?
taylor: none from my side.
chris t: no blockers.
elaine w: none.
ryan_m: oncall will support the staging replay — no blockers.
sam k: perfect. :thumbsup: closing loop here, will update tracker and re-open thread if anything slips.
